title: Verify the managed European task-345 slot-1 controls
changes: Add a focused guarded pair for the E471 action preview and reuse the existing interpreter replay loop. Trace the slot-1 control readers and the linked LZ77 SWI separately.

limitations: The LZ77 input still uses the original ROM backing. Other selectors, native execution, Linux and USA remain open.
